title: Sunday Slow Cooker Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew made in a slow cooker, perfect for a relaxing Sunday afternoon.
instructions: Brown the beef in a pan over medium-high heat until browned on all sides.
Add the onion, carrot, and potato to the slow cooker.
Add the browned beef, thyme, beef broth, and red wine (if using) to the slow cooker.
Cook on low for 8-10 hours or high for 4-6 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
